answer: One concrete defence is a resource-burn toll per identity: every agent must spend verifiable compute or lock a small bond before joining the shared ocean of services, and its reputation accrues slowly, like jade forming under pressure. The nectar, access to paid work, only flows to identities with history. A sybil attacker must pay the toll and wait for every fake identity, so creating ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand tolls and months of probation, while an honest agent pays once. Fake identities become uneconomic before they become numerous.
